entries.29ac652d3f15f648: The company wholesales products such as equipment and supplies used by researchers and engineers to scientific equipment dealers. It mainly uses a catalog sales format, providing product information through paper catalogs, WEB sites and other means and selling to users through dealers. In China, the consolidated subsidiary Yasuwang (Shanghai) Shangmao Co., Ltd. sells scientific equipment for research and other products, Nikko Hansen Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells plastic containers for scientific experiments and other products, AS ONE INTERNATIONAL, INC. mainly exports North American products to Japan and other countries, and Custom Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells electronic measuring instruments and related products.
entries.30fd601212cbac89: A specialized trading company that delivers scientific instruments, equipment and consumables used in research, industrial and medical settings to researchers and medical professionals through distributors.
entries.3427a70b5d22add2: It sells wholesale to scientific equipment distributors and medical and nursing care distributors, and through these distributors delivers products to end users such as universities, research institutions, research and production departments of companies, medical institutions and nursing care facilities. There is no specific customer accounting for 10% or more of revenue from external customers.

entries.3ab677345b18f8d5: As a hub connecting suppliers, retailers and end users, the company has carried out industry-first measures, including a broad product lineup, product information provided through catalogs and the internet, development of e-commerce tools tailored to clients' business scale, and quick delivery backed by ample inventory and a distribution network. Through wider use of the centralized purchasing system for large users “ocean” and the EC support system for retailers “Wave”, the company contributes to streamlining its customers' purchasing operations.

entries.5a0a18b2c096dbcd: This is the Group's main business. As a specialized trading company handling scientific equipment, fixtures and similar items used in various laboratories, research institutions, production facilities, medical facilities and other sites, it sells equipment, fixtures, consumables and other items on a wholesale basis. This is the only reportable segment. The operation of the logistics warehouses for both divisions is outsourced to the consolidated subsidiary Iuchi Logistics Co., Ltd.
entries.6139ab862165d656: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥110,698 million (up 6.7% year on year), marking the 16th consecutive period of higher revenue. Sales by division were ¥93,185 million for the Lab & Industry Division, ¥16,925 million for the Medical Division, and ¥587 million for other.
entries.633f625fe7c226b7: The company’s management philosophy is “Innovation and Creation,” and its purpose is to connect people, goods, information and services in the research, industrial and medical fields, supporting the activities of researchers and healthcare professionals. Its long-term vision “AS ONE VISION-2035,” formulated in May 2025, aims to create a platform where research resources are “visible, connected and within reach,” in order to resolve the “3 nai” (okane ga nai, jikan ga nai, mottainai) that researchers face: no money, no time, and waste. Under the medium-term management plan “FY2025-27” (covering the fiscal year ended March 2026 through the fiscal year ended March 2028), the company aims for sustained growth of its existing businesses and also targets discontinuous growth through active use of M&A and alliances.
